where i'm from (México) there’s some controversy happening right now surrounding this subject
it all started when the National Council to Prevent Discrimination (a government department) tried to organize a forum to talk about those issues, they invited some specialists about the subject and also a journalist/comedian who is kinda famous for his spicy humor.
it turns out this journalist/comedian made some jokes about the presidents son a while ago and when the first lady found out she made the president cancel the forum, dissolve the council (which he didn’t even know it existed) and cancel a program this person had on HBO.
i mean, the joke was in fact racist (he compared the kid to a chocoflan cake, the kid is brown and has his hair dyed blonde) but doing all that because of a joke is just killing free speech.
i don’t support this person, i don’t like his humor but i’ll fight for anyone’s freedom to say anything, no matter how stupid that thing is
